description: For total computable \(F(e,a)\), put \(d(b)=s(b,b)\) and \(G(e,\langle a,x\rangle)\simeq\varphi_{F(s(e,a),a)}(x)\). There is one \(r\) with \(\varphi_r(\langle b,y\rangle)\simeq G(d(b),y)\) for all \(b,y\). Then \(q=d(r)\) and the single primitive-recursive \(h(a)=s(q,a)\) satisfy \(\varphi_q(y)\simeq G(q,y)\) for all \(y\) and \(\varphi_{h(a)}(x)\simeq\varphi_{F(h(a),a)}(x)\) for all \(a,x\).
